claims.statement: If H is real symmetric with zero diagonal, H=lambda vv^T+R is obtained by removing a top-modulus eigenpair, and ||R||=s_2(H)<=tau, then |H_ij|<=tau for every i!=j.
For every fixed 0<=tau<1/2, under the full owner target hypotheses, s_2(A-diag A)<=tau implies an essentially bounded density with ||p_Q||_infinity <= max(50(1-tau)^(-3/4), pi/sqrt(1-2tau)).
Under the full owner target hypotheses, s_2(A-diag A)<=499/1000 implies ||p_Q||_infinity<84.
Pay the surviving high-offdiagonal s_2(A-diag A)>499/1000 branch by combining spectral-window localization with O0-heavy/O1/O2/O3 third-compound overlap structure in original product coordinates.

partner_applied.application: Transfers the same-sign physical-pair interval inequality pi/sqrt(1-2tau) from bounded finite-union product indicators to all independent cap-one densities without constant loss.

fresh_peer_consumed.application: Uses its opposite-diagonal payment and improves its low-offdiagonal 3/10 threshold by sharpening the zero-diagonal entry estimate from 2tau to tau.
